answer.justification: The annular pruritic plaque with hyphae on KOH confirms tinea corporis, a dermatophyte infection. Although small lesions usually respond to topical therapy, among the listed systemic agents griseofulvin is the standard choice. Clindamycin and doxycycline treat bacterial infections, while itraconazole is typically an alternative for refractory disease.
